scenes.title: The Lantern Run
scenes.card: A fisherman’s daughter steals the village’s Great Lantern during a foggy festival night, and the chase that follows lights the way home for fourteen lost boats.

scenes.title: The Great Lantern
scenes.card: The mayor will light the Great Lantern tonight. Brother Ferris guards it.

subtitles.text: Mayor Pim: Neighbours! Tonight the Great Lantern lights our festival!
Sal: Brightest lamp in the county.
Mayor Pim: Brother Ferris, guard it until the feast.
Brother Ferris: I never sleep on duty.

hud.text: The Great Lantern lights the festival

scenes.title: Fog at sea
scenes.card: Fog traps the fishing boats. Captain Rue says the broken beacon cannot be replaced.

subtitles.text: Dot: Papa! The fog is thick. The boats cannot see the harbour!
Captain Rue: The old beacon cracked last week. Nothing bright enough.
Dot: What about the Great Lantern?
Captain Rue: It belongs to the village, Dot. Not to us.

hud.text: The boats are lost in the fog

scenes.title: Asleep on duty
scenes.card: While the guard sleeps, Dot takes the lantern and runs. Ferris wakes too late.

subtitles.text: Brother Ferris: Wha? Thief! Stop! Somebody stop that child!

scenes.title: Stop that thief!
scenes.card: The village chases Dot through the market. Nell trips over a crate.

subtitles.text: Sal: Stop right there, little thief!
Nell: My cakes! Somebody catch her!

scenes.title: Cornered on the quay
scenes.card: The chase ends at the quay. Dot holds the lantern and will not give it up.

subtitles.text: Sal: Give it back, child!
Dot: I cannot. Not yet.
Mayor Pim: Dot! That is the village lantern! Explain yourself!

scenes.title: The reason
scenes.card: Dot explains: she took the lantern to guide the fishing boats home through the fog.

subtitles.text: Captain Rue: Dot! What have you done?
Dot: The boats are lost in the fog, Papa. I wanted them to see a light.
Mayor Pim: Fog over the whole bay. And fourteen boats out there.
Nell: Oh, the poor sailors.

scenes.title: Light the harbour
scenes.card: Everyone agrees to place the lantern at the quay to guide the boats.

subtitles.text: Mayor Pim: A lantern belongs where it is needed. Dot, put it on the quay stand.
Sal: Look at that glow. Like a small sun.

scenes.title: The boats come home
scenes.card: The fishing fleet follows the lantern into the harbour. Everyone is saved.

subtitles.text: Dot: Papa! Look! A mast!
Captain Rue: Fourteen boats, and every one of them following that light!

hud.text: Will the boats find the way?

scenes.title: Festival at the quay
scenes.card: The village celebrates at the harbour. Everyone toasts Dot.

subtitles.text: Mayor Pim: Neighbours! The festival is moved to the quay tonight!
Nell: I will fetch every cake in the village.
Mayor Pim: To Dot, who stole the lantern and saved the fleet!
Brother Ferris: And to me, who was asleep for all of it.
Sal: Especially you.
